content:
Following up on today's decision to [SFI EIP-8141](<https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/12251>): it was proposed as a headliner and CFI'd with the understanding that it would be revisited at a later date for both SFI and headliner status.

Generally, headliners are auto-SFI'd but non-headliners have to meet [SFI criteria](<https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-7723#scheduled-for-inclusion>). Today's decision to SFI left it in limbo because I failed to explicitly clarify whether the decision to SFI was an intention to name it headliner - I'll put that on the agenda for next ACDE for us to 'ratify' whether it's a headliner or we just progressed a non-headliner without meeting SFI criteria 😅 

-----

IMO, moving to headliner status doubles down on the fact that we intend to ship Hegotá with AA even though important and productive conversations are still happening around the best way to not fracture standards across the ecosystem. The specific implementation that we ship is an L1 decision: it will ultimately be up to the core devs. But making certain to address concerns brought to ACD by large user bases creates trust in this governance process, so I urge us to keep the conversation productive and attend the AA breakouts to see what solutions we can approach.
